proposals.name: postprocess_execution_distortion_source_v1
proposals.rationale: Candidate-level raw-to-SG/postprocess/PerfectTracker distortion is current-tick and atomizable in isolation, but existing raw-prefix, materiality, postprocess/tracker descriptor, and support-bottleneck gates already closed this family as insufficient. This proposal is intentionally fail-closed unless new non-equivalence evidence is supplied.
